title: Synthetic Testbed Validation: Rank Collapse Measurement, RAMA vs Baselines, and Gate Behavior Analysis
summary: Demonstrates a three-phase synthetic testbed validation of Rank-Aware Moment Aggregation (RAMA): (A) rank collapse measurement with variance-entropy proxy validation (Spearman=0.85), (B) comparison of 5 aggregation methods (Mean, UngatedMeanVar, RAMA, PNA, VPA) on regression and classification tasks where RAMA achieves best regression R²=0.74, (C) RAMA gate behavior analysis showing gate-cardinality correlation (Spearman=0.82). Uses 81 curated examples from 6 conditions (low/medium × rank 2/8/16) with 3 seeds, 50 epochs, and all 5 methods. Training completes in ~71s on CPU.
